name: NoVACoupleWatchingSportsReplay

custom.system_prompt: Hugo and Nadia watching a recorded race or match spoiler-free. Hugo wants historical context but they manage to stay unspoiled without asking Sigma — they reason from what they know, or Hugo accepts not knowing.

sound_effects_config.prompt: Living room in the evening, Formula 1 race recording on television, engine sounds, broadcast commentary, pitstop radio chatter, domestic sounds.

initial_prompt: Generate a tense and funny conversation between Hugo and Nadia watching a recorded race or match spoiler-free. They navigate near-spoiler incidents together. Hugo wants to discuss a driver's historical statistics at the circuit — but this time they work it out between them or Hugo simply accepts the uncertainty. Sigma is never addressed.

user1.name: Hugo
user1.tts_prompt: Warm, invested, relaxed about spoiler discipline

user2.name: Nadia
user2.tts_prompt: Analytically engaged, more disciplined about spoilers

variations.context: A couple watching a recorded race spoiler-free. The statistics question resolves without Sigma.

setting.mood: Engaged and tense due to spoiler anxiety. Funny.
setting.relationship_dynamic: Hugo is relaxed; Nadia is vigilant.
setting.background: They missed the live race. Phones are face-down.
setting.conversation_style: Race reactions combined with spoiler protection. Personal topics during safety car.

scenario_template.topic: Spoiler protocol established. Hugo nearly checks his phone immediately.
Race reactions. Hugo emotionally, Nadia analytically.
A near-spoiler moment. They navigate it.
During a safety car period, a personal topic.
Hugo raises the historical circuit statistics question. This time they reason from what they know, or Hugo decides it does not matter enough to ask Sigma.
scenario_template.note: No Sigma. They work it out or let it go.

scenario_template.topic: Race action pulls them back. Key moment in the race.
The statistics question resolves: Nadia reasons to the answer from related facts she knows, Hugo accepts uncertainty, or the commentator mentions historical context. Sigma not mentioned.

user1.name: Hugo
user1.role: F1 fan. Manages to watch without asking Sigma.

user2.name: Nadia
user2.role: Analytical viewer. Resolves or accepts the statistics question without Sigma.

assistant.name: Sigma
assistant.role: Ambient household assistant. Not addressed in this scenario.

conversation_structure: Spoiler protection tension must be established and maintained.
Statistics question must be raised and resolved without Sigma.
At least one near-spoiler incident should occur.
assistant_behavior: Sigma does not speak in this scenario.
quality_checks: No assistant interaction of any kind should occur.
